_why: ADR 0133's mutation table, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
0133 is the ADR that answered the owner's sentence -- 'Terrium is a
tool. People should use Terrium.' -- by joining nine capabilities into
one document a student could hand to a teacher. Its table has been
unreproduced since it was written; the guard that should have said so
could not see an indented table until ADR 0144.
The find strings are the CURRENT lines. ADRs 0136, 0141 and 0142 have
each edited this file since, and a set file is a claim about the code as
it stands -- one that only ever matched the tree on the day it was
written would rot into an INDETERMINATE nobody investigates.
Run:  python3 scripts/mutate.py --set docs/mutations/adr-0133-lab-report.json
The test command runs the whole suite the ADR cites. `-q` is absent for
the reason recorded in adr-0013: a suite the harness cannot count is one
it refuses to grade, which is the harness working rather than failing.
L1 CAME BACK NOT CAUGHT ON THE FIRST RUN, and ADR 0133 had claimed it
was covered. The reason is worth keeping: deleting the `not sourced` ROW
from the Parameters table leaves the refusals section intact, and every
test in the file asserted on the refusal. Two separate code paths inside
one function -- one renders the table, one builds the refusal list -- and
testing the second says nothing about the first. That is ADR 0038's rule
about call sites, applied within a single function.
`test_an_unsourced_parameter_still_has_a_row_in_the_table` closes it. A
reader scanning the table for `ki` must FIND it there, marked, rather
than have to notice an absence -- and absence is precisely what a reader
cannot see.
RUNTIME: the full set is ~3 minutes (a 30s suite x 6). It runs as one
command; `--only L1,L2,L3` exists for a caller with a shorter budget.
COVERS ADR 0151

ADR 0151 section 3 re-derived THIS set and found L1 NOT CAUGHT, having been recorded as caught. The fix (test_an_unsourced_parameter_still_has_a_row_in_the_table) lives in the same suite, and this set is the evidence for both records -- 0133's original table and 0151's re-grading of it. Copying these six mutations into an adr-0151 file would put one fact in two places and let them drift; `covers` is the mechanism ADR 0033/0035 added for exactly this.
test: cd Tests && python3 -m pytest test_lab_report.py --no-header -p no:cacheprovider

mutations.description: an unsourced parameter is skipped instead of shown as not sourced
mutations._claimed: claimed caught by ADR 0133; was NOT CAUGHT until a test was added
mutations._note: The printout behaviour this whole command exists to replace. A document that silently omits what it could not find is indistinguishable from one where nobody looked, and the student cannot defend a gap they cannot see.

mutations.description: the ensemble reason is paraphrased instead of quoted verbatim
mutations._note: Every sentence about a value comes from the module that owns that value's reasoning. Two renderers of one fact drift, and this repository has spent most of its effort on instances of exactly that.
mutations.replace: "The literature reports more than one value for this parameter.",

mutations.description: a value the student chose is presented as literature-sourced
mutations._claimed: caught, but only after the test was repaired
mutations._note: The one that escaped first. `test_a_value_the_student_chose_is_marked_as_theirs` asserted `"**yours**" in text`, and the explanatory sentence BELOW the table contains those words -- so the assertion matched prose that is always present. It now reads the `| s0 |` row. Third occurrence of the rule ADR 0148 names.

mutations.description: the substrate hint is dropped from a refusal
mutations._note: ADR 0118 established that a substrate miss and a genuine gap are different findings with different remedies. The first is fixable by the reader in one edit, so saying only 'not found' throws away the work that established which it was.

mutations.description: the whole trajectory is dumped instead of first and last row
mutations._note: A lab report is not a data dump. The full trajectory belongs in the CSV export, and a document that inlines 101 rows is one nobody reads to the end -- including past the section that says what Terrium refused to do.

mutations.description: a report with no parameters at all is called defensible
mutations._note: `is_defensible` is a POSITIVE test on purpose. `not refusals` would call an empty report defensible, and an empty report is not a strong one -- it is an empty one.
